title: Garh AI regulatory rule pack
description: Data-only DSL for NBC / municipal bye-law / Vastu rule packs. A pack is a list of rules; each rule is a gate (`when`) plus a typed `check`. Packs carry NO executable code: the engine implements a closed set of check types (see `x-garh-check-meta`) and a closed set of `when` context fields (see $defs.predicate). The engine MUST reject a pack that references an unknown check type, an unknown `when` field, or an unknown `custom.fn` -- silently passing an unrecognised rule would report a house as compliant when it was never checked. Geometry is integer millimetres and areas integer square millimetres throughout; ratios are exact integer num/den pairs. There is not a single floating-point number in a valid pack.

schemaVersion.description: Version of THIS DSL. Bumped when check types or context fields change; the engine refuses a schemaVersion it does not implement.

idPrefix.description: Every rule id in this pack MUST start with `<idPrefix>.`. Rule ids are globally unique across all packs -- a child pack never redefines a parent id, it disables it via `overrides`.

version.description: Pack data version, YYYY.MM[.patch]. Compliance reports pin this so a report can always be re-explained with the exact rules that produced it.

authority.description: The body that issues these rules (BIS, BBMP, DDA, GHMC, ...). Shown in the UI next to every citation.

extends.description: Parent pack id, or null for a root pack. Resolution: load the parent chain root-first, then this pack's rules; apply this pack's `overrides` to inherited rules; merge `vocabulary` key-by-key (child key replaces parent key wholesale, never element-wise). Cycles are a load error.

citations_base.description: Prefix for every rule `cite` in this pack. Full citation shown in the UI = `citations_base + ' ' + rule.cite`.

confidenceDefault.description: Confidence applied to any rule that omits `confidence`. Seed packs authored by the Garh team MUST set this to "seed".

status.description: Pack-level position on the confidence ladder. See rulepacks/README.md.

reviewers.description: Empanelled local architects who signed off. Empty for seed packs.

disclaimer.description: Verbatim text the UI and every export MUST show alongside results from this pack. Advisory, not approval.

notes.description: Author notes about the pack as a whole: table structure, deliberate omissions (a nil statutory requirement produces NO rule), known gaps.

sources.description: Documents the pack was authored from. A seed pack lists what a reviewer must obtain to verify it.

obtained.description: false = the authoring team did not have the primary document in hand. Seed packs are honest about this.

vocabulary.description: Pack-owned classifications. These are regulatory judgements, not code constants, so they live in the pack: the engine reads them to derive `roomIsHabitable` and the area bases used by far_max / coverage_max.

habitableRoomTypes.description: Derives the `roomIsHabitable` context field: roomIsHabitable == (roomType in habitableRoomTypes).

wetRoomTypes.description: Used by the solver's plumbing-stack score and by ventilation defaults.

openRoomTypes.description: Room types that count as 'open' for brahmasthan_open.

farExclusions.description: What the model layer must exclude when computing `farCountableAreaMm2` for this jurisdiction.

coverageInclusions.description: What the model layer must ADD to the ground-floor slab when computing `footprintAreaMm2`.

scoring.description: Present only on advisory scoring packs (Vastu). When present EVERY rule in the pack must carry `weight`.

modeField.description: The context field that selects the mode. Closed set: only vastuMode exists today.

aggregate.description: score = scale.max * SUM(weight_i * satisfaction_i) / SUM(weight_i), over APPLICABLE rules only (a rule with no matching element is excluded from both sums). satisfaction_i is an exact rational in [0,1]: 1 when the target is in `allow`, `fallback.scoreRatio` when in `fallback.allow`, 0 otherwise. With several matching elements, satisfaction_i is their arithmetic mean (exact rational).

rounding.description: Applied once, to the final score only. Never to intermediate rationals.

modes.description: `off` is absent by design: when the mode field is `off` the pack is not loaded at all.

groups.description: Presentation grouping for the compass-wheel breakdown. Group weight is DERIVED (sum of member rule weights) -- never duplicated here.

overrides.description: How this pack alters INHERITED rules. Ids stay globally unique: a city pack disables an NBC rule and adds its own, it never shadows an id.

action.description: `relax-to-warn` keeps the check but clamps severity. `replace` requires `replacedBy`.

items.description: Scoring packs need a weight (for the 0-100 aggregate) and a group (for the per-rule UI breakdown) on every rule.

x-garh-check-meta.$comment: Machine-readable contract for the engine. `scope` = what the engine iterates to build one evaluation per rule; the rule's `when` is evaluated against the project context PLUS the fields bound by that scope. `resultUnit` = the unit of `actual` and `limit` in the result row. `worst` = how several instances of a scope collapse into one rule result (worst status wins; `elements[]` lists every offender).

scopes.project: evaluated once; only project-level `when` fields are bound
scopes.edge: once per plot edge named by check.edge; binds edgeRoadWidthMm
scopes.room: once per room; binds roomType, roomIsHabitable, roomIsInternal, storeyIndex
scopes.opening: once per opening; binds openingKind, openingRole, storeyIndex
scopes.zone: evaluated once, but the check selects its own target elements (see zone_check.target)

setback_min.actual: plot.edges[selected].setbackProvidedMm (min across edges when the selector names several)

height_max.actual: model.buildingHeightMm - SUM(model.heightComponentsMm[k] for k in check.excludes)

floors_max.actual: model.storeyCount + COUNT(check.counts entries present in the model)

ventilation_ratio_min.limit: max(ceil(ratio.num * room.areaMm2 / ratio.den) if ratio else 0, minAreaMm2 or 0)

projection_max.actual: projection.projectionMm (only projections whose element matches, and whose intoSetback matches when check.intoSetbackOnly is true)

parking_min.limit: max(ceil(rate.num * basisQuantity / rate.den), minSpaces or 0); basisQuantity = profile.dwellingUnits | model.builtUpAreaMm2

zone_check.actual: sorted unique zone/facing labels of the matched targets

args.flag: name of the boolean profile field that declares a rainwater-harvesting structure

rwh_required.semantics: actual = profile[args.flag]; limit = true. Deliberately a declaration check, not a geometric one: the MVP model has no RWH element, so the pack must not pretend to verify sump volume.

args.maxEnclosedRatio: exact ratio of the centre (C) cell that a single non-open room may cover
args.openRoomTypes: room types that do not count as enclosing (falls back to vocabulary.openRoomTypes when omitted)

brahmasthan_open.semantics: actual = max over non-open rooms of floor(10000 * area(room.polygonMm INTERSECT centreCell) / area(centreCell)); limit = floor(10000 * maxEnclosedRatio). Fails when actual > limit.

statuses.warn: check violated and rule severity is warn (or a mode ceiling clamped it)
statuses.fail: check violated and rule severity is fail
statuses.not_applicable: `when` was not satisfied, or the scope produced no instances. Excluded from scores. The API may omit these rows.

x-garh-check-meta.nullSemantics: A numeric operator applied to a null context field (e.g. roadWidthMm on a plot with no road set yet) yields FALSE, so the rule becomes not_applicable. It never silently passes.
x-garh-check-meta.combination: Several properties inside one `when` are ANDed. Several operators on one field are ANDed. There is no OR and no NOT: use `in` for set membership, or author two rules. An absent/empty `when` means the rule always applies.
x-garh-check-meta.stacking: Two `*_min` rules on the same target both apply; the strictest effectively governs. This is intentional -- city front-setback tables are indexed by plot size AND road width, and the pack encodes them as two independent rule families whose maximum is the real requirement.

ruleId.description: Dotted, lowercase, stable forever: compliance reports, user overrides and annotations reference it. First segment == pack.idPrefix. Never reuse an id for a different meaning; retire it and add a new one.

confidence.description: seed = drafted by the Garh team from secondary sources, NOT authoritative. reviewed = an empanelled local architect checked it against the primary document. verified = reviewed AND confirmed against a sanctioned drawing or municipal desk. The UI shows this next to every result; seed values render with a caution marker.

severity.description: fail = hard rule: the solver discards options that violate it and the UI shows a red chip. warn = advisory chip. Neither ever blocks the user (SKILL.md golden rule 5).

ratio.description: Exact rational. FAR 1.75 is {num:175,den:100}; 'one tenth of the floor area' is {num:1,den:10}; 60% coverage is {num:60,den:100}. The engine cross-multiplies with integers -- no float ever touches a compliance verdict.

roomType.description: Mirrors the model core's RoomType. `kitchen_dining` / `living_dining` / `bath_wc` are the combined-room types NBC treats separately -- the pack selects on them directly instead of on a boolean flag.

openingRole.description: Functional role of an opening, assigned by the model layer (solver or user). Drives the door-width minima.

edgeSelector.description: `sides` = both side edges (worst of the two). `all` = every edge.

zone.description: Cell of the 3x3 grid over the plot, oriented to TRUE north. Derivation: rotate the plot boundary counter-clockwise by plot.northDeg so true north becomes +Y, take the axis-aligned bounding box, split into 3 equal columns x 3 equal rows (cell boundaries rounded half-up to whole mm). Top row = NW,N,NE; middle = W,C,E; bottom = SW,S,SE. An element's zone = the cell containing its centroid; a centroid exactly on a boundary belongs to the higher-index (more N / more E) cell. C is the brahmasthan.

compass8.description: Facing sector. Derivation: azimuth = (element.outwardNormalDeg - plot.northDeg) mod 360, where outwardNormalDeg is the plot-local bearing measured clockwise from +Y. Sectors are 45 deg wide and centred on the cardinal: N = [337.5,22.5), NE = [22.5,67.5), E = [67.5,112.5), and so on.

predicate.description: THE CLOSED CONTEXT FIELD SET. `additionalProperties: false` is the load-bearing part of this schema: an unknown field must be a hard load error, because a typo like `roadWidthmm` would otherwise make a rule silently apply to every plot (or none) and report a compliant house. Adding a field means bumping schemaVersion and teaching the engine to bind it.

cityPack.description: profile.cityPack -- the city preset in force.

plotAreaSqm.description: Plot area in WHOLE square metres, the unit every bye-law table is banded in. Thresholds are integers and the engine compares exactly: `{lte: 360}` means plot.areaMm2 <= 360 * 1000000. Nothing is rounded, so a 360.4 m2 plot correctly falls outside a <=360 band. Use plotAreaMm2 when a band is not a whole number of m2.

plotAreaMm2.description: plot.areaMm2. Use for bands defined in imperial units, e.g. 1200 sq ft = 111480000 mm2.

plotFrontageMm.description: plot.frontageMm -- width along the front edge. null when no front edge is set.

roadWidthMm.description: Width of the road abutting the FRONT edge (the primary access road). null when no road is set on the front edge.

edgeRoadWidthMm.description: Road width on the edge currently under evaluation. Bound only for edge-scoped checks; null (hence not_applicable) elsewhere.

cornerPlot.description: plot.cornerPlot -- two or more edges abut roads that meet.

abuttingRoadCount.description: Number of plot edges with a road.

storeys.description: model.storeyCount -- habitable storeys above ground, stilt and basement excluded.

buildingHeightMm.description: model.buildingHeightMm -- ground level to highest point, nothing excluded.

builtUpAreaMm2.description: model.builtUpAreaMm2 -- gross built-up area, all storeys.

storeyIndex.description: 0 = ground. Bound for storey/room/opening/stair/projection scopes only.

roomIsHabitable.description: Derived: roomType in vocabulary.habitableRoomTypes. Room scope only.

roomIsInternal.description: Room has no wall on the building envelope. Room scope only.

enforce.description: true = the solver treats rules marked `hard` as CP-SAT constraints (§5.2 strict mode). false = pure scoring, the solver only rewards satisfaction.

severityCeiling.description: Every rule's severity is clamped to at most this. `warn` in advisory mode is how one rule set serves both modes without duplicating ids.

score.description: Whether to compute and surface the 0-100 score.

autofix.description: Powers the 'Fix it' button (§15). Advisory only -- the client computes the actual op payload and always shows it as a reversible diff first.

opType.description: An op `type` from playbook §4, e.g. `wall.move`, `opening.resize`, `plot.set_reg_profile`. Validated against the generated op catalogue at pack load.

computable.description: false = show the hint text only, no button (the fix needs a re-solve or a human decision).

title.description: Short label for tables and the compliance annexure.

message.description: One-line human chip text, plain and warm, never blaming (§15). Placeholders the engine substitutes: {element} {actual} {limit} {cite}. Numbers are formatted per resultUnit (mm2 -> m2 with 2 decimals, mm -> m with 2 decimals or mm for small values).

when.description: Applicability gate. Absent = the rule always applies.

cite.description: Clause/table reference, appended to the pack's citations_base.

citeUrl.description: Deep link to the published document, when one exists.

fix.description: What the architect should do, in one sentence.

weight.description: Relative weight in a scoring pack's 0-100 aggregate. Required when the pack declares `scoring`; meaningless otherwise.

group.description: Id of a scoring.groups entry -- the breakdown bucket the compass wheel renders this under.

hard.description: In a scoring pack: this constraint is absolute (Vastu's never-NE toilet) and the solver may encode it as a CP-SAT constraint when the mode enforces. Ignored in advisory mode beyond severity clamping.

supersedes.description: Inherited rule ids this rule is intended to replace. Informational: the actual disabling happens in pack-level `overrides`.

notes.description: Author's working notes: what still needs verification, which table cell this came from.

type.description: The complete set of check types the engine implements. 18 types, no extensibility except `custom`, whose `fn` is itself a closed enum.

check_setback_min.description: Minimum open space between the plot line and the building line on the selected edge(s). scope=edge, resultUnit=mm.

measure.description: `to-projection` measures to the outermost balcony/chajja instead of the wall face.

check_far_max.description: Floor Area Ratio / FSI cap. scope=project, resultUnit=mm2 (allowed vs achieved FAR-countable area). The UI derives the familiar '1.82 vs 1.75' by dividing by plot area.

premium.description: Extra FAR purchasable/allowed on conditions. NOT applied automatically -- surfaced as a note so the architect decides.

excludes.description: Components subtracted from model.buildingHeightMm before comparing. Most bye-laws exclude parapet, mumty and overhead tank.

check_floors_max.description: Maximum number of floors. scope=project, resultUnit=count. `value: 3` means G+2.

counts.description: Extra levels that count toward the limit. Omit/empty = stilt and basement are free.

check_room_area_min.description: Minimum carpet area of a room. scope=room, resultUnit=mm2. Select the rooms with `when.roomType` / `when.roomIsHabitable`.

check_room_width_min.description: Minimum least width of a room. scope=room, resultUnit=mm. Least width = the smaller side of the room polygon's axis-aligned bounding box (MVP is orthogonal-only; revisit if non-orthogonal walls ship).

check_ceiling_height_min.description: Minimum clear floor-to-ceiling height. scope=room, resultUnit=mm. Clear height = storey height minus slab thickness and any dropped ceiling, computed by the model layer.

check_ventilation_ratio_min.description: Minimum openable area for light and ventilation. scope=room, resultUnit=mm2. With both params the requirement is the LARGER of the two, which is how NBC states bathrooms (a ratio floored by an absolute minimum).

ratio.description: Fraction of the room's floor area, e.g. {num:1,den:10}.

countKinds.description: Which opening kinds the model layer counts toward the openable area.

check_stair_width_min.description: Minimum clear flight width. scope=stair, resultUnit=mm.

check_headroom_min.description: Minimum clear headroom measured vertically from the nosing line. scope=stair, resultUnit=mm.

check_projection_max.description: Maximum projection beyond the building line. scope=projection, resultUnit=mm.

intoSetbackOnly.description: true = only projections that encroach on a required setback are checked.

check_parking_min.description: Minimum on-site parking. scope=project, resultUnit=count. required = max(ceil(rate x basisQuantity), minSpaces).

basis.description: `dwelling` -> rate is spaces per dwelling unit. `built-up-area` -> rate is spaces per mm2 of built-up area (2 ECS per 100 m2 is {num:2,den:100000000}).

spaceSizeMm.description: [width, length] of one equivalent car space, for the site-plan check and the area statement.

check_opening_width_min.description: Minimum clear width of an opening. scope=opening, resultUnit=mm. Select with `when.openingKind` + `when.openingRole`. NOTE: this type is an addition to the list in playbook §6 -- §6's seed values include door minima but no check type covered them.

check_zone_check.description: Directional placement check (Vastu). scope=zone, resultUnit=zone. Status: pass when every matched target is in `allow` and none in `deny`; warn when a target falls in `fallback.allow`; fail (clamped by the mode's severityCeiling) otherwise. Satisfaction for scoring: 1 in allow, fallback.scoreRatio in fallback, 0 elsewhere; mean over matched targets. No matched target -> not_applicable and excluded from the score.

mode.description: `zone` = which 3x3 cell the target's centroid sits in. `facing` = which 45 deg compass sector the target's outward normal points to.

deny.description: Hard-never directions. A target here is always a violation, whatever `allow` says.

fallback.description: Acceptable-but-not-ideal directions, scored at a fraction (Vastu's kitchen NW at half score).

zoneOrCompass.description: A 3x3 zone when mode=zone; a compass sector when mode=facing (in which case `C` is invalid).

storeyIndex.description: Restrict to one storey; omit for all storeys.

check_custom.description: Escape hatch for the two checks that are not expressible as a comparison. `fn` is a CLOSED enum -- registering a new function means bumping schemaVersion, so a pack can never name code that does not exist.
